gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id) AS job, SUM(woi.quantity) AS item_qty FROM work_orders wo JOIN customers c ON c.id = wo.customer_id JOIN work_order_items woi ON woi.work_order_id = wo.id WHERE DATE(wo.created_at) = '2026-06-09' GROUP BY c.name, COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id)
notes: ROOT CAUSE: create_date/delivery_date/actual_delivery_date are 100% NULL decoys; real timestamp is created_at. Job id = work_number (fallback id) per the app; work_order_number is a dead column. 'done' reinterpreted as 'created' (no completion date tracked). Today-anchored: June 9 = 2026-06-09.

question: who owes us the most money this month
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(bb.balance) AS outstanding FROM (SELECT b.id, b.customer_id, SUM((bi.price * bi.quantity - COALESCE(bi.discount, 0)) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tax, 0) / 100)) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id = j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id = b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'PAYABLE', 'CASH', 'BANK') AND j.debit > 0), 0) AS balance FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id = b.id WHERE b.type = 'Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.customer_id) bb JOIN customers c ON c.id = bb.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING outstanding > 0 ORDER BY outstanding DESC LIMIT 1
notes: Receivable model from the app (DebtorsReportComponent + Bill::balance()): per-invoice balance = amount [SUM((price*qty - discount)*(1+tax/100))] minus payments [SUM(journal.debit) on CASH/BANK/PAYABLE/OPERATING_EXPENSE accounts linked by bill_id], summed per customer, positives only. Running balance, so 'this month' dropped. Earlier RECEIVABLE-journal draft was wrong (returned negative). CLARIFY-OK: question says 'this month' and gold silently drops it; asking which window is the honest product answer, so a clarification scores.
